title: cheilanthes pteridioides subsp. maderensis
intro: Cheilanthes pteridioides subsp. maderensis, commonly known as Madeira fern, is a subspecies of fern that belongs to the Aspleniaceae family. This plant has been traditionally used in medicine for its various health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation and improve respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma. The therapeutic actions of Cheilanthes pteridioides subsp. maderensis include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its healing and protective effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, tannins, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
